import numpy as np
from scipy.sparse import diags, eye, kron
from scipy.sparse.linalg import splu


def calibrate_affine_banks(
    raw_observations: np.ndarray, observation_banks: np.ndarray,
    reference_levels: np.ndarray, sweep_readouts: np.ndarray, sweep_banks: np.ndarray,
    *, historical_profiles: np.ndarray | None = None, match_rtol: float = 5e-6,
    clip_rtol: float = 0.05, signal_scale: float | None = None,
) -> np.ndarray:
    """Invert raw = gain * reference + offset for positive-gain instruments.

    Inputs are matched 1-D arrays with nonnegative integer bank IDs. Historical
    profiles have shape (profile, bank ID, 2) with columns (gain, offset).
    Rank profiles by number of misses at match_rtol, then clipped L1 loss at
    clip_rtol, both relative to signal_scale (default: max absolute sweep level
    or readout). Tied profiles transfer only agreed parameters. An informative
    current fit takes precedence if it has at least four sweeps or no profile
    match; with four or more sweeps, screen at 4.5 robust residual scales.
    No gain ridge is used. Without level variation, retain the transferred or
    unit gain; unmatched sparse checks update the offset by median residual.
    """
    raw, x, y = (np.asarray(a, dtype=float) for a in (raw_observations, reference_levels, sweep_readouts))
    banks, ids = (np.asarray(a) for a in (observation_banks, sweep_banks))
    if raw.ndim != 1 or banks.shape != raw.shape or x.ndim != 1 or y.shape != x.shape or ids.shape != x.shape:
        raise ValueError('Supply matched one-dimensional measurement and bank arrays')
    if any(a.size and (not np.issubdtype(a.dtype, np.integer) or np.any(a < 0)) for a in (banks, ids)):
        raise ValueError('Bank IDs must be nonnegative integers')
    if match_rtol < 0 or clip_rtol <= match_rtol or (signal_scale is not None and signal_scale <= 0):
        raise ValueError('Require a positive signal scale and 0 <= match_rtol < clip_rtol')
    if not raw.size:
        return raw.copy()
    banks, ids = banks.astype(int, copy=False), ids.astype(int, copy=False)
    count = max(int(banks.max()), int(ids.max()) if ids.size else -1) + 1
    params = np.tile([1., 0.], (count, 1))
    matched = np.zeros(count, dtype=bool)
    scale = signal_scale
    if scale is None:
        scale = max(np.max(np.abs(x), initial=0.), np.max(np.abs(y), initial=0.))
        if scale == 0:
            scale = np.max(np.abs(raw))
    if historical_profiles is not None:
        profiles = np.asarray(historical_profiles, dtype=float)
        if (profiles.ndim != 3 or profiles.shape[1] < count or profiles.shape[2] != 2
                or not np.isfinite(profiles).all() or np.any(profiles[..., 0] <= 0)):
            raise ValueError('Historical profiles must cover the banks and have finite positive gains')
        profiles = profiles[:, :count]
        if len(profiles):
            error = np.abs(profiles[:, ids, 0] * x + profiles[:, ids, 1] - y)
            inlier = error <= match_rtol * scale
            misses = (~inlier).sum(axis=1)
            loss = np.minimum(error, clip_rtol * scale).sum(axis=1)
            eligible = misses == misses.min()
            best = eligible & (loss <= loss[eligible].min() + 1e-12 * scale)
            candidates = profiles[best]
            gain_agrees = np.ptp(candidates[..., 0], axis=0) <= 1e-12 * candidates[..., 0].max(axis=0)
            offset_agrees = np.ptp(candidates[..., 1], axis=0) <= 1e-12 * scale
            consensus = np.column_stack((gain_agrees, offset_agrees))
            params = np.where(consensus, np.median(candidates, axis=0), params)
            for b in np.flatnonzero(gain_agrees & offset_agrees):
                matched[b] = np.any(np.all(inlier[best][:, ids == b], axis=0))
    for b in np.unique(banks):
        xb, yb = x[ids == b], y[ids == b]
        if not xb.size:
            continue
        span = np.ptp(xb)
        if span > 0 and (xb.size >= 4 or not matched[b]):
            u, v = (xb - np.median(xb)) / span, yb - np.median(yb)
            keep = np.ones(xb.size, dtype=bool)
            if xb.size >= 4:
                i, j = np.triu_indices(xb.size, 1)
                du = u[j] - u[i]
                distinct = np.abs(du) > 1e-12
                slopes = (v[j[distinct]] - v[i[distinct]]) / du[distinct]
                slopes = slopes[slopes > 0]
                if slopes.size:
                    residual = v - slopes[:, None] * u
                    errors = np.abs(residual - np.median(residual, axis=1, keepdims=True))
                    scores = np.median(errors, axis=1)
                    best = scores.argmin()
                    robust_scale = max(1.4826 * scores[best], 1e-12 * np.ptp(v))
                    candidate = errors[best] <= 4.5 * robust_scale
                    if candidate.sum() >= 2 and np.ptp(u[candidate]) > 1e-12:
                        keep = candidate
            uc = u[keep] - u[keep].mean()
            vc = v[keep] - v[keep].mean()
            gain = (uc @ vc) / (uc @ uc) / span
            if gain > 0:
                params[b] = (gain, yb[keep].mean() - gain * xb[keep].mean())
                continue
        if not matched[b]:
            params[b, 1] = np.median(yb - params[b, 0] * xb)
    gain, offset = params[banks].T
    return (raw - offset) / gain


def reaction_transport_design(
    lengths: tuple[float, float], diffusivities: tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray],
    velocities: tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray], robin: tuple[float, float],
    baseline_reactions: tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray], reaction_field: np.ndarray,
    source_modes: np.ndarray, shifts: np.ndarray, sensor_indices: np.ndarray,
    *, coupling_threshold: float = 1e-3, enhanced_diffusivity_factor: float = 1.45,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, float]:
    """Solve shifted steady transport on a uniform cell-centered rectangle.

    Diffusivities are positive (L^2/T); velocities and nonnegative Robin
    transfers use L/T. Each axis has the same transfer at its two exterior
    faces. The row-wise first-order upwind stencil uses a zero exterior inflow
    value. Reactions and shifts have units 1/T; source modes (M,nx,ny) have
    field units per time. The grid reaction adds to the baseline axis reactions.
    Keep it in full, which is equivalent to augmenting the two axis diagonals
    for an additive grid. Scale diffusivity before computing face fluxes only
    above the relative Frobenius gate. The shifted operators must be invertible;
    no forward regularization is added. Return shift-first sensor rows,
    last-shift fields (nx,ny,M), and the dimensionless nonadditivity diagnostic.
    """
    reaction, modes, shifts = (np.asarray(a, dtype=float) for a in (reaction_field, source_modes, shifts))
    if reaction.ndim != 2 or not reaction.size or modes.ndim != 3 or not modes.shape[0] or modes.shape[1:] != reaction.shape:
        raise ValueError('Supply a nonempty reaction grid and matching source modes')
    if shifts.ndim != 1 or not shifts.size or min(lengths) <= 0 or min(robin) < 0:
        raise ValueError('Require shifts, positive lengths and nonnegative Robin transfer')
    if coupling_threshold < 0 or enhanced_diffusivity_factor <= 0:
        raise ValueError('Invalid regime parameters')
    nx, ny = reaction.shape
    peak = np.max(np.abs(reaction))
    coupling = 0.0
    if peak > 0:
        r = reaction / peak
        defect = r - r.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True) - r.mean(axis=0) + r.mean()
        coupling = float(np.linalg.norm(defect) / np.linalg.norm(r))
    factor = enhanced_diffusivity_factor if coupling > coupling_threshold else 1.0
    ell = max(lengths)
    axes = []
    for a, n in enumerate((nx, ny)):
        k, v, base = (np.asarray(coeff[a], dtype=float) for coeff in (diffusivities, velocities, baseline_reactions))
        if k.shape != (n,) or v.shape != (n,) or base.shape != (n,) or np.any(k <= 0):
            raise ValueError('Supply cellwise axis coefficients with positive diffusivities')
        h = (lengths[a] / ell) / n
        k, v, transfer = factor * (k / ell**2), v / ell, robin[a] / ell
        p, m = np.maximum(v, 0) / h, np.maximum(-v, 0) / h
        q = 2 * k[:-1] * k[1:] / (k[:-1] + k[1:]) / h**2
        main = base + p + m
        main[:-1] += q
        main[1:] += q
        ends = np.array([0, n - 1])
        np.add.at(main, ends, transfer * k[ends] / (h * (transfer * h / 2 + k[ends])))
        axes.append(diags(main, format='csc') if n == 1 else
                    diags((-q - p[1:], main, -q - m[:-1]), (-1, 0, 1), format='csc'))
    op = (kron(axes[0], eye(ny), format='csc') + kron(eye(nx), axes[1], format='csc')
          + diags(reaction.ravel(order='C'), format='csc'))
    sensors = np.asarray(sensor_indices)
    if sensors.ndim != 2 or sensors.shape[1] != 2 or not np.issubdtype(sensors.dtype, np.integer):
        raise ValueError('Sensor indices must be integer grid-cell pairs')
    if np.any(sensors < 0) or np.any(sensors >= (nx, ny)):
        raise ValueError('Sensor cell index outside the grid')
    i, j = sensors.T
    identity = eye(nx * ny, format='csc')
    rhs = modes.reshape(modes.shape[0], nx * ny, order='C').T
    rows = []
    for shift in shifts:
        fields = splu(op + shift * identity).solve(rhs).reshape(nx, ny, modes.shape[0], order='C')
        rows.append(fields[i, j])
    return np.vstack(rows), fields, coupling


def fit_box_simplex(
    design: np.ndarray, observations: np.ndarray, nuisance: np.ndarray,
    *, cap: float, budget: float, source_ridge: float, nuisance_ridge: float = 0.0,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, dict[str, float | np.ndarray]]:
    """Minimize (||R(Dw-y)||^2 + source_ridge*||w||^2)/2 on a box simplex.

    R is the direct ridge-fit residual operator, applied to all columns and
    observations. Default nuisance ridge zero gives orthogonal projection;
    pass shape (n_rows,0) for no nuisance. Source ridge must be positive.
    Each ridge scales as the square of the corresponding design-column units.
    The active-set gradient tolerance is 1e-12 after normalization. The
    certificate uses g - nu_sum - lam_lower + lam_upper = 0 and a tangent
    lower bound on the optimal objective.
    """
    D, y, Z = (np.asarray(a, dtype=float) for a in (design, observations, nuisance))
    if D.ndim != 2 or y.shape != (D.shape[0],) or Z.ndim != 2 or Z.shape[0] != D.shape[0]:
        raise ValueError('Design, observations and nuisance must share rows')
    n = D.shape[1]
    if n == 0 or cap <= 0 or not 0 <= budget <= n * cap or source_ridge <= 0 or nuisance_ridge < 0:
        raise ValueError('Require a feasible box simplex and valid ridge penalties')
    data = np.column_stack((D, y))
    if Z.shape[1]:
        if nuisance_ridge == 0:
            data -= Z @ np.linalg.lstsq(Z, data, rcond=None)[0]
        else:
            U, s, _ = np.linalg.svd(Z, full_matrices=False)
            data -= U @ ((s**2 / (s**2 + nuisance_ridge))[:, None] * (U.T @ data))
    S, r = data[:, :-1], data[:, -1]
    A = cap * S
    H = A.T @ A + source_ridge * cap**2 * np.eye(n)
    c = -(A.T @ r)
    scale = max(np.max(np.abs(H)), np.max(np.abs(c)))
    H, c = H / scale, c / scale
    if budget == 0:
        x, nu = np.zeros(n), c.min()
    elif budget == n * cap:
        x = np.ones(n)
        nu = (H @ x + c).max()
    else:
        x = np.full(n, budget / (n * cap))
        state = np.zeros(n, dtype=int)
        for _ in range(100 * n):
            g = H @ x + c
            free = np.flatnonzero(state == 0)
            if not free.size:
                lo = np.argmin(np.where(state < 0, g, np.inf))
                hi = np.argmax(np.where(state > 0, g, -np.inf))
                if g[hi] - g[lo] <= 1e-12:
                    nu = (g[hi] + g[lo]) / 2
                    break
                state[[lo, hi]] = 0
                continue
            block = H[np.ix_(free, free)]
            a, b = np.linalg.solve(block, np.column_stack((g[free], np.ones(free.size)))).T
            nu = a.sum() / b.sum()
            step = nu * b - a
            alpha = np.full(free.size, np.inf)
            np.divide(1 - x[free], step, out=alpha, where=step > 1e-14)
            np.divide(-x[free], step, out=alpha, where=step < -1e-14)
            hit = alpha.argmin()
            if alpha[hit] < 1:
                x[free] += max(0., alpha[hit]) * step
                index = free[hit]
                state[index] = 1 if step[hit] > 0 else -1
                x[index] = float(state[index] > 0)
                continue
            x[free] += step
            violation = state * (H @ x + c - nu)
            release = violation.argmax()
            if violation[release] <= 1e-12:
                break
            state[release] = 0
        else:
            raise RuntimeError('Box-simplex active set did not converge')
    w = np.clip(x, 0., 1.) * cap
    nu = float(nu * scale / cap)
    residual = S @ w - r
    g = S.T @ residual + source_ridge * w
    lower, upper = np.maximum(g - nu, 0.), np.maximum(nu - g, 0.)
    primal = float(0.5 * (residual @ residual + source_ridge * (w @ w)))
    bound = primal + nu * (budget - w.sum()) - lower @ w - upper @ (cap - w)
    return w, {'weights': w.copy(), 'nu_sum': nu, 'lam_lower': lower,
               'lam_upper': upper, 'primal_objective': primal, 'dual_lower_bound': float(bound)}
",

def run_self_test():
    lengths = (2., 4.)
    k = (np.array([1., 3.]), np.array([2., 6.]))
    v = (np.array([-.4, .2]), np.array([.6, .2]))
    robin = (.5, .4)
    base = (np.array([.2, .6]), np.array([.4, .1]))
    shifts = np.array([.2, .8])
    sensors = np.array([[1, 1], [0, 0], [1, 0], [0, 1]])
    perm = np.array([2, 0, 3, 1])
    row_perm = np.r_[perm, len(sensors) + perm]
    truth = np.array([[[1., 0., 0.], [0., 2., 0.]], [[0., 0., 3.], [1., -1., .5]]])
    for interaction, f in ((0., 1.), (.6, 1.45)):
        reaction = np.array([[.1, .2], [.3, .4 + interaction]])
        # Independent two-cell stencils in physical units: dx=1, dy=2.
        qx, qy = 1.5*f, .75*f
        Ax = np.array([[qx+.4+.2+.5*f/(.25+f), -qx-.4],
                       [-qx-.2, qx+.2+.6+1.5*f/(.25+3*f)]])
        By = np.array([[qy+.3+.4+.8*f/(2*(.4+2*f)), -qy],
                       [-qy-.1, qy+.1+.1+2.4*f/(2*(.4+6*f))]])
        op = np.kron(Ax, np.eye(2)) + np.kron(np.eye(2), By) + np.diag(reaction.ravel())
        rhs = (op + shifts[-1]*np.eye(4)) @ truth.reshape(4, 3)
        modes = rhs.T.reshape(3, 2, 2)
        design, terminal, coupling = reaction_transport_design(lengths, k, v, robin, base, reaction, modes, shifts, sensors)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(coupling, interaction/(2*np.linalg.norm(reaction)), atol=2e-15)
        assert (coupling > 1e-3) == (f > 1.)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(terminal, truth, atol=2e-12)
        first = np.linalg.solve(op + shifts[0]*np.eye(4), rhs).reshape(2, 2, 3)
        i, j = sensors.T
        np.testing.assert_allclose(design, np.vstack((first[i, j], truth[i, j])), atol=2e-12)
        # Length x0.01, rate x2, and sensor-order covariance.
        ell, rate = .01, 2.
        scaled_design, scaled_terminal, scaled_coupling = reaction_transport_design(
            tuple(ell*a for a in lengths), tuple(ell**2*rate*a for a in k),
            tuple(ell*rate*a for a in v), tuple(ell*rate*a for a in robin),
            tuple(rate*a for a in base), rate*reaction, rate*modes, rate*shifts, sensors[perm])
        np.testing.assert_allclose(scaled_design, design[row_perm], atol=2e-12)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(scaled_terminal, terminal, atol=2e-12)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(scaled_coupling, coupling, atol=2e-15)
        # Grid cells are observation rows, not reciprocal links. An upper-triangular
        # subset is valid without the reversed off-diagonal cell.
        take = np.flatnonzero(sensors[:, 0] <= sensors[:, 1])
        subset, _, _ = reaction_transport_design(lengths, k, v, robin, base, reaction, modes, shifts, sensors[take])
        np.testing.assert_allclose(subset, design[np.r_[take, len(sensors)+take]], atol=2e-12)
        assert all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in (design, terminal, coupling, scaled_design, scaled_terminal, scaled_coupling, subset))

    w_true, gradient, ridge = np.array([0., .4, .6]), np.array([.3, .1, -.2]), .2
    Z = np.zeros((len(design), 1)); Z[0, 0] = 1.
    d = np.ones(len(design)); d[0] = .5  # Direct residual operator for unit nuisance ridge.
    raw_residual = np.linalg.lstsq(design.T * d**2, gradient - ridge*w_true, rcond=None)[0]
    y = design @ w_true - raw_residual
    gain, offset = np.array([1.6, .75, 1.2, .85]), np.array([.2, -.1, .3, -.4])
    historical = np.column_stack((gain, offset)); historical[2, 1] = .1
    latest = np.column_stack((np.ones(4), np.zeros(4)))
    profiles = np.stack((historical, latest))
    ids = np.array([0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 2])
    ref = np.array([-2., -1., 0., 1., 2., -1., 2., 1.5])
    reads = gain[ids]*ref + offset[ids]; reads[2] += 25.
    banks = np.array([0, 1, 2, 3, 0, 3, 2, 1])
    raw = gain[banks]*y + offset[banks]
    calibrated = calibrate_affine_banks(raw, banks, ref, reads, ids, historical_profiles=profiles)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(calibrated, y, atol=2e-12)
    missing = calibrate_affine_banks(raw, banks, ref, reads, ids, historical_profiles=profiles[1:])
    assert np.max(np.abs(missing - y)) > .01
    signal = 1e-3

    scaled_y = calibrate_affine_banks(signal*raw[row_perm], banks[row_perm], signal*ref,
                                     signal*reads, ids, historical_profiles=scaled_profiles)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(scaled_y, signal*y[row_perm], atol=2e-14)

    w, cert = fit_box_simplex(design, calibrated, Z, cap=.6, budget=1., source_ridge=ridge, nuisance_ridge=1.)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(w, w_true, atol=2e-11)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(w.sum(), 1., atol=2e-12)
    assert np.all((0 <= w) & (w <= .6))
    np.testing.assert_allclose(terminal @ w, truth @ w_true, atol=2e-11)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(cert['nu_sum'], .1, atol=2e-11)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(cert['lam_lower'], [.2, 0., 0.], atol=2e-11)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(cert['lam_upper'], [0., 0., .3], atol=2e-11)
    objective = .5*(np.linalg.norm(d*raw_residual)**2 + ridge*(w_true @ w_true))
    np.testing.assert_allclose(cert['primal_objective'], objective, atol=2e-12)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(cert['dual_lower_bound'], objective, atol=2e-12)
    scaled_w, scaled_cert = fit_box_simplex(signal*scaled_design, scaled_y, Z[row_perm], cap=.6, budget=1.,
                                            source_ridge=ridge*signal**2, nuisance_ridge=1.)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(scaled_w, w, atol=2e-11)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(scaled_cert['dual_lower_bound']/signal**2, objective, atol=2e-12)
    assert all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in (calibrated, missing, scaled_y, w, scaled_w, *cert.values(), *scaled_cert.values()))


run_self_test()
